pages.text: Only a matching four-piece set can gain/store energy. Lesser capacity: 250; ascended: 1000. Removing a piece or mixing tiers clears energy. Hit +5, kill +15, crit +3; Star Core adds +1. Decay: 1/second after 10 seconds out of combat. Resonance no longer raises capacity. The altar fills set energy but does not grant a free shield.
